notes.title: We have just released a major update of our game "Elden Gunfire"
notes.content:
Hello everyone

-We have just released a major update 1.3.9 of our game "Elden Gunfire" with new features:
-better advanced bots system more challenging that reacts like real players.
-big boost of game performance when switching to lower graphics setting witch now support dynamic screen render resolution
-now you can see the game leaderboard in the game community to check all steam players highest scores:
https://steamcommunity.com/stats/2768050/leaderboards/12676143/

-few maps adjusted design
-adjusted game UI
-few bugs fixed

Check out the game page for more details and give us your reviews to support the game.
Thank you
